description:
Maggie Sellers Reum says one of the most underrated parts of building a business is knowing who to call.

At Forbes x Hot Smart Rich After Hours in New York City, the @HotSmartRich founder spoke with ForbesWomen editor Maggie McGrath about expanding her circle when she became an entrepreneur—and learning the power of sharing advice, opportunities and access with other women.
title: “I Had To Change A Lot Of My Friends When I Became An Entrepreneur”
